summary: BioForce Nanosciences Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a change of control on April 15, 2026. Director Merle Ferguson sold 26.7 million common shares (79.65% of outstanding stock) to Nexus Capital Investments for $400,000 in corporate funds, with no loans involved. This private transaction resulted in a change of control. Subsequently, on June 17, 2026, Co-CEOs Steven Gagnon and John LaViolette, and VP Sasha Shapiro resigned, and Scott Mager was appointed director. No board recommendation or advisor named. The filing is classified as 'Other' as the transaction is a privately negotiated stock sale and concurrent management change, not a public acquisition or tender offer.
